title: A Person to Talk To
goal: Put a preposition before the relative word and keep the subjunctive: una persona con la que pueda hablar.

items: I can ask for a person or place with a preposition + relative + subjunctive.
I can choose between quien and el que after a preposition.
I can use the new words for trust and support.
